responsibility: Implements the C-family preprocessing-only output path used by -E and related modes. It configures cpplib callbacks, scans the translation unit as tokens or directives-only streams, reproduces preprocessed text with correct spacing and line markers, emits queued macro definition/undefinition dumps for -d* options, copies pragmas and include traces as requested, and preserves enough source-location state for recompilable preprocessor output including PCH replay directives.
